meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取解析流式细胞术标准数据文件并支持生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要处理流式细胞术实验的 FCS 数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写 FCS 2.0~3.1 流式细胞术文件:解析元数据与通道标签、把事件数据提取成 NumPy 数组、导出 CSV/DataFrame,也能新建 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要解析 FCS 文件、提取事件数据、查看通道与元数据时触发;也用于导出 CSV 或新建 FCS 文件。补偿、门控等分析原文建议改用 FlowKit。

say.text: 读取 sample.fcs,告诉我版本、事件数和通道名
say.note: 返回版本、事件数、PnN/PnS 通道标签

say.text: 把这份 FCS 的事件数据导出成 CSV
say.note: 转成 DataFrame 后写出 CSV

say.text: 把这段数据存成 FCS 3.1 文件,通道叫 FSC-A、SSC-A、FL1-A
say.note: create_fcs 输出单精度浮点 FCS 3.1

howto.what_en: Reads and writes FCS 2.0-3.1 flow cytometry files: parses metadata and channel labels, extracts events as NumPy arrays, exports to CSV/DataFrame, and creates FCS 3.1 files.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to parse FCS files, extract event data, or inspect channels and metadata, export to CSV, or create new FCS files. For compensation or gating, the source suggests FlowKit.

say_en.text: Read sample.fcs; show version, event count, channel names
say_en.note: Returns version, event count, PnN/PnS labels

say_en.text: Export the event data from this FCS file to CSV
say_en.note: Converts to DataFrame and writes CSV

say_en.text: Save this data as an FCS file with channels FSC-A, SSC-A, FL1-A
